document_metadata.title: POLARIS Stage 8.1 EMS V4 Engineering Design / Specification Gate

v3_mechanism_handoff.governing_interpretation: V3 mechanism evidence indicates that the Class F improvement is strongly consistent with reduced optimizer sensitivity to later-horizon forecast-dependent operational costs. Individual forecast-horizon contributions were not isolated.
v3_mechanism_handoff.classification: B — STRONGLY SUPPORTED BUT NOT FULLY ISOLATED
v3_mechanism_handoff.upgrade_prohibition: Do not upgrade this mechanism from B to A.

v4_design_principles.intervention_rule: Test a clearly defined engineering hypothesis with ONE controlled intervention per experiment.
prohibited_actions: Lowering gamma further without structural rationale
Searching for the lowest diesel value
Modifying forecast model, simulator, synthetic truth, or evaluation population
v4_design_principles.parameter_discipline: All V4 parameters must be formally PREDECLARED prior to implementation/execution. Candidates requiring missing scientific inputs must be marked CONDITIONALLY SPECIFIED / NOT IMPLEMENTATION-READY.

source_inspection_findings.primary_insertion_point: Lines 86-135 (objective vector c construction) & Lines 243-265 (commitment constraints)
source_inspection_findings.immutable_aspects: DispatchPlan schema, unmet load penalty weighting (unweighted), linear energy balance
24h receding horizon loop, timestep ordering, data provider interaction
Closed-loop state update, battery efficiency, physical SOC limits
Schema version 1.0.0, units W/m^2 and W, 24h forecast arrays
Initial station conditions across all 173 origins

candidate_inventory.engineering_objective: Test whether a targeted piecewise horizon-weighting function preserves Class F fuel reduction while eliminating unnecessary discounting of near horizons t in [0..5].
candidate_inventory.mechanism_targeted: Late-horizon forecast error sensitivity (h >= 14, t >= 13) without discounting near-horizon cost fidelity (t in [0..5]).
candidate_inventory.evidence_supporting_mechanism: V3 proved late-horizon discounting suppresses over-reaction. Near horizons (t in [0..5]) have high forecast accuracy.
candidate_inventory.evidence_uncertain: Whether discounting near horizons (t in [0..5]) contributed positively to Class F fuel reduction or was superfluous.
candidate_inventory.mathematical_formulation: w_t = 1.0 if t < t_knee else gamma_late^(t - t_knee + 1)
candidate_inventory.units: t_knee in timesteps (integer), gamma_late dimensionless float ratio
candidate_inventory.proposed_predeclared_value: NOT YET PREDECLARED (Proposal for Gate 2A: t_knee=6, gamma_late=0.95)
candidate_inventory.timing_index_semantics: t=0 corresponds to h=1; t=13 corresponds to h=14.
candidate_inventory.receding_horizon_interaction: Re-evaluated at every receding horizon origin k over relative window t in [0..23].
candidate_inventory.interaction_with_gamma_0_95: Replaces uniform gamma=0.95^t with un-discounted head (w_t=1.0 for t<6) and decaying tail (w_t=0.95^(t-5) for t>=6).
candidate_inventory.safety_implications: Unmet load penalty remains unweighted (c[unmet] = penalty * dt).
candidate_inventory.forecast_preservation: Stage 8.1 forecast point vectors passed without alteration.
candidate_inventory.simulator_preservation: Closed-loop simulator physical updates remain unchanged.
candidate_inventory.telemetry_requirements: Step-level objective weights w_t, horizon cost distribution J_t.
candidate_inventory.expected_mechanism_signature: Near-horizon operational decisions (t<6) retain full cost sensitivity; late-horizon penalties (t>=6) exponentially suppressed.
candidate_inventory.falsification_criterion: Rejection if piecewise weighting increases mean diesel fuel consumption compared to V3 Class F (gamma=0.95) or fails to maintain 0 unmet load.
candidate_inventory.potential_failure_mode: If significant forecast error occurs at t < t_knee, un-discounted head re-introduces premature diesel commitment.

candidate_inventory.engineering_objective: Test whether applying differential discount factors to distinct operational objective terms (specifically discounting distant renewable curtailment penalties with gamma_curt < 1.0 while keeping gamma_fuel = 1.0 for diesel fuel/startup costs) isolates and mitigates premature diesel commitment without discounting fuel costs.
candidate_inventory.mechanism_targeted: De-coupling fuel cost sensitivity from renewable curtailment penalty sensitivity over distant forecast horizons.
candidate_inventory.evidence_supporting_mechanism: V3 evidence indicates V2 premature diesel commitment was triggered by optimizer attempts to avoid projected mid/late horizon renewable curtailment / battery overflow.
candidate_inventory.evidence_uncertain: Whether fuel cost terms themselves require discounting or if curtailment penalty discounting alone accounts for the fuel reduction.
candidate_inventory.mathematical_formulation: c[curt_t] = curt_penalty * dt * gamma_curt^t; c[fuel_t] = fuel_cost * marg_fuel * dt * gamma_fuel^t; c[start_t] = startup_cost * gamma_start^t
candidate_inventory.proposed_predeclared_value: NOT YET PREDECLARED (Proposal for Gate 2A: gamma_curt=0.90, gamma_fuel=1.0, gamma_start=1.0)
candidate_inventory.receding_horizon_interaction: Applied to objective vector at each step k.
candidate_inventory.interaction_with_gamma_0_95: Replaces uniform gamma=0.95 across all terms with term-specific vector (gamma_curt, gamma_fuel, gamma_start).
candidate_inventory.forecast_preservation: Stage 8.1 forecast point vectors passed unaltered.
candidate_inventory.telemetry_requirements: Term-decoupled objective values J_fuel, J_curt, J_start per origin.
candidate_inventory.expected_mechanism_signature: High relative weight on immediate/future diesel costs versus suppressed weight on distant renewable curtailment penalties.
candidate_inventory.falsification_criterion: Rejection if term-specific discounting increases diesel fuel consumption compared to V3 Class F or causes un-served load.
candidate_inventory.potential_failure_mode: If gamma_fuel=1.0 while gamma_curt=0.90, optimizer may over-curtail renewables in later horizons if actual solar is available.

candidate_inventory.engineering_objective: Test whether objective discounting can dynamically adapt based on detected forecast structure (activating discount factor gamma_active = 0.95 only when forecast solar irradiance exhibits high late-horizon variability/slope, otherwise maintaining gamma_passive = 1.0).
candidate_inventory.mechanism_targeted: Selective application of horizon discounting only during volatile forecast regimes, avoiding discounting during stable clear-sky or polar night conditions.
candidate_inventory.evidence_supporting_mechanism: V3 horizon analysis proved h=14 solar bias (+19.72 W/m^2) occurs predominantly during active daytime solar transitions.
candidate_inventory.evidence_uncertain: Whether a deterministic threshold rule on forecast vector variance/slope can reliably trigger discounting without introducing chattering or state-aliasing.
candidate_inventory.exact_intervention_boundary: Inside LocalMILPEnergyOptimizer.optimize() prior to objective vector assembly.
candidate_inventory.mathematical_formulation: S(y) = (1/12) sum_{t=12}^{23} |y_sol,t - y_sol,t-1|; gamma(S) = gamma_active if S >= S_thresh else 1.0
candidate_inventory.units: S_thresh in W/m^2/h, gamma_active dimensionless float
candidate_inventory.proposed_predeclared_value: NOT YET PREDECLARED (Proposal: S_thresh=15.0 W/m^2/h, gamma_active=0.95)
candidate_inventory.timing_index_semantics: Calculated over late-horizon steps t in [12..23] at origin k.
candidate_inventory.receding_horizon_interaction: Dynamically evaluated at each origin k.
candidate_inventory.interaction_with_gamma_0_95: Conditionally switches between gamma=1.0 and gamma=0.95.
candidate_inventory.safety_implications: Unmet load penalty unweighted under both modes.
candidate_inventory.forecast_preservation: Reads forecast point vector; no modifications made.
candidate_inventory.telemetry_requirements: Forecast structure metric S_k, active gamma_k state per step.
candidate_inventory.expected_mechanism_signature: Binary mode switching of gamma_k strongly correlated with forecast volatility.
candidate_inventory.falsification_criterion: Rejection if structure-aware weighting causes higher diesel consumption than static gamma=0.95 or exhibits instability across adjacent origins.
candidate_inventory.potential_failure_mode: Threshold misclassification causing gamma=1.0 to be active during an over-prediction event.

candidate_inventory.engineering_objective: Test whether MILP optimization using explicit forecast lower/upper confidence bounds rather than point forecasts alone can prevent premature diesel commitment while maintaining load reliability.
candidate_inventory.mechanism_targeted: Direct optimizer response to forecast interval width / quantile uncertainty.
candidate_inventory.evidence_supporting_mechanism: ForecastBundle schema defines lower, point, upper arrays.
candidate_inventory.evidence_uncertain: Current Stage 8.1 forecast artifacts output degenerate point forecasts (lower = point = upper). No calibrated probabilistic uncertainty model exists for Stage 8.1.
candidate_inventory.constraint_preservation: Modifies upper bound vectors of generation constraints.
candidate_inventory.telemetry_requirements: Quantile spread f_upper - f_lower, effective solar cap.
candidate_inventory.expected_mechanism_signature: Conservative solar generation bounds during wide uncertainty intervals.
candidate_inventory.falsification_criterion: Rejection if interval bounds force unnecessary diesel generation when solar is actually available.
candidate_inventory.potential_failure_mode: Over-conservative lower-bound dispatch causing excess diesel commitment.
candidate_inventory.governance_classification: B — CONDITIONALLY READY / MISSING REQUIRED INPUT
candidate_inventory.missing_prerequisite: A calibrated probabilistic forecast engine / quantile forecast artifact for Stage 8.1 is NOT available.

candidate_inventory.engineering_objective: Test whether enforcing a dynamic, forecast-aware battery SOC lower bound floor E_min,dynamic(t) (reserving battery SOC prior to projected low-solar windows) reduces diesel commitment independently of objective horizon discounting.
candidate_inventory.mechanism_targeted: Explicit physical state reservation (E_min(t) constraint) rather than cost function penalty discounting.
candidate_inventory.evidence_supporting_mechanism: V3 mechanism analysis proved battery SOC positioning at t=0..3 directly determines subsequent diesel commitment at t=8..18.
candidate_inventory.evidence_uncertain: Whether a dynamic SOC floor can prevent premature diesel commitment without causing forced diesel charging when SOC drops near the floor.
candidate_inventory.mathematical_formulation: E_min,dynamic(t) = E_min,base + Delta E_reserve * max(0, 1 - y_sol,t / Y_ref); lb[base + 6] = E_min,dynamic(t)
candidate_inventory.units: Delta E_reserve in Wh, Y_ref in W/m^2
candidate_inventory.valid_parameter_domain: Delta E_reserve in [0.0, E_cap - E_min,base], Y_ref > 0.0
candidate_inventory.proposed_predeclared_value: NOT YET PREDECLARED (Proposal: Delta E_reserve=20000 Wh, Y_ref=100 W/m^2)
candidate_inventory.receding_horizon_interaction: Applied to decision variable lower bounds at step k.
candidate_inventory.interaction_with_gamma_0_95: Tested at baseline gamma=1.0 to isolate SOC reserve mechanism.
candidate_inventory.telemetry_requirements: Computed lb[base + 6] profile and actual SOC trajectory.
candidate_inventory.expected_mechanism_signature: Battery SOC profile maintained above dynamic floor prior to evening peak.
candidate_inventory.falsification_criterion: Rejection if SOC reserve floor forces additional diesel charging or increases total fuel relative to baseline.
candidate_inventory.potential_failure_mode: Higher SOC floor restricts usable battery capacity, forcing diesel generator to run during minor load spikes.

candidate_inventory.engineering_objective: Test whether adding explicit minimum runtime constraints (T_min,on) to diesel generator commitment logic alters dispatch pathways and fuel efficiency independently of horizon weighting.
candidate_inventory.mechanism_targeted: Structural commitment hysteresis preventing short-duration diesel start/stop cycling.
candidate_inventory.evidence_supporting_mechanism: V3 reduced startup count from 1.03 to 0.76 per origin; explicit commitment logic tests whether physical commitment rules achieve fuel efficiency without objective discounting.
candidate_inventory.evidence_uncertain: Whether minimum runtime constraints lower total fuel or force the generator to run longer than necessary once committed.
candidate_inventory.mathematical_formulation: sum_{tau=t}^{min(t + T_min,on - 1, H-1)} u_diesel(tau) >= T_min,on * v_start(t) for all t in [0..H-1]
candidate_inventory.receding_horizon_interaction: Interacts with initial state station_state.diesel_hours_running at t=0.
candidate_inventory.interaction_with_gamma_0_95: Tested at baseline gamma=1.0 to isolate hysteresis.
candidate_inventory.constraint_preservation: Adds linear constraints to MILP matrix A.
candidate_inventory.telemetry_requirements: Generator run duration distribution, startup timestamps, u_diesel binary trace.
candidate_inventory.expected_mechanism_signature: Total elimination of 1-hour diesel runs in dispatch plans.
candidate_inventory.falsification_criterion: Rejection if T_min,on increases diesel fuel consumption by forcing extended runtime after load deficit has cleared.
candidate_inventory.potential_failure_mode: Forced minimum runtime causes excess fuel burn and mandatory renewable curtailment while generator operates at P_min.

candidate_inventory.engineering_objective: Directly test the un-isolated mechanism identified in the V3 handoff by discounting ONLY horizon h=14 (t=13) while keeping all other horizons t != 13 unweighted (w_t = 1.0), isolating whether h=14 forecast bias (+19.72 W/m^2) was the necessary and sufficient driver of Class F performance.
candidate_inventory.mechanism_targeted: Isolated single-horizon forecast error sensitivity (specifically targeting h=14 / t=13).
candidate_inventory.evidence_supporting_mechanism: V3 Mechanism Handoff explicitly states: 'h=14 corresponds to t=13, h=14 forecast bias = +19.72 W/m^2, w_13 = 0.5133... individual forecast-horizon contributions were NOT independently isolated.' Candidate V4.G directly targets this exact qualification!
candidate_inventory.evidence_uncertain: Whether discounting t=13 alone reproduces the -13.28 L/origin fuel reduction or if multi-horizon cumulative decay (t=8..23) is required.
candidate_inventory.mathematical_formulation: w_t = w_target if t == t_target (t_target=13) else 1.0
candidate_inventory.units: t_target integer index in [0..23], w_target dimensionless float in [0.0, 1.0]
candidate_inventory.proposed_predeclared_value: NOT YET PREDECLARED (Proposal: t_target=13, w_target=0.5133, matching V3 Class F weight at t=13)
candidate_inventory.receding_horizon_interaction: Applied to relative step t=13 for each origin step k.
candidate_inventory.interaction_with_gamma_0_95: Directly isolates the t=13 component of gamma=0.95^13 = 0.5133.
candidate_inventory.telemetry_requirements: Target step cost contribution c_13 * x_13, trajectory divergence step.
candidate_inventory.expected_mechanism_signature: Divergence of dispatch trajectory specifically matching V3 Class F while retaining full weights for t != 13.
candidate_inventory.falsification_criterion: Rejection if discounting t=13 alone fails to significantly reduce diesel fuel compared to V2, proving that multi-horizon cumulative discounting is required.
candidate_inventory.potential_failure_mode: If forecast error is distributed across t=10..16, discounting t=13 alone might be insufficient to alter early battery positioning.

candidate_inventory.engineering_objective: Combine multiple candidate interventions simultaneously (e.g. compounding piecewise horizon weighting + commitment hysteresis + SOC reserve floor) or discount near horizons (t in [0..3]).
candidate_inventory.mechanism_targeted: Unfocused compounding of multiple physical and mathematical controls.
candidate_inventory.evidence_supporting_mechanism: None. V3 evidence showed near-horizon forecasts have minimal bias, and multi-policy compounding prevents causal attribution.
candidate_inventory.evidence_uncertain: Compounding makes causal mechanism identification impossible.
candidate_inventory.governance_classification: C — NOT JUSTIFIED BY CURRENT EVIDENCE
candidate_inventory.rationale: Violates V4 core design principle (Prefer ONE intervention per V4 experiment). Unmotivated by V3 empirical evidence.

future_3arm_experiment_design.primary_endpoint: Total diesel fuel liters per 24h origin (L/origin)

next_governance_gate.action: Review V4 Design Gate, select a single candidate class for evaluation, and freeze its predeclared parameter values before authorizing code implementation or execution.
